chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ruled that the one on the right should be given precedence in speaking in a gathering.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْيَمِينِ: the person on the right side

ai.seo_question: Who should speak first in a gathering according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a ruling of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding etiquette in gatherings. It establishes that precedence in speaking is given to the person on the right, reflecting ordered conduct and respect in social settings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3240 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) ruled that the one on the right should speak first in a gathering."
